chapter_mission: Galactic Alliance Guard authorized by Cal Omas; Toryaz Station peace summit announced as the galaxy's last diplomatic option; Tresina Lobi established as Mara's oldest friend in advance of the bombing.
chapter_turn: The Alliance formally militarizes its internal-security apparatus while simultaneously staging a peace summit — the book's cleanest display of institutional self-contradiction.

scene_plan.purpose: Omas authorizes the Galactic Alliance Guard over private objections; Toryaz summit announced.
Mara and Tresina Lobi plan their Toryaz meeting.

exit_vector: Mara and Tresina Lobi on a Coruscant balcony agreeing to meet at Toryaz — a conversation the reader will recognize as doom.
notes: Tresina Lobi gets the book's only scene for her — Allston plants the friendship exactly as long as the bombing requires.
